covariance.note: Full NxN covariance (absolute units^2, in units of the product of the two bins' yunit scales, i.e. 10^-72 cm^4/Ar^2 x appropriate GeV powers) sliced from the release's blockwise cov.txt using the GlobalBin index sets for the 6 distributions above, concatenated in listed order (Kp; Xp Emu; Xp costheta_mu; 0p 2d slices in order; Np 2d slices in order; Xp 2d slices in order), each slice's bins in file order. sqrt(diag) reproduces the per-bin err column exactly (by construction) and matches the paper's own Supplemental Material Uncertainty column to <1% (rounding).
